$comment: The ten composite scenarios from 01-PRD.md § 8. The flag sets here are canonical and must match that table exactly -- the admin API applies them verbatim and does not interpret them.

scenarios.name: Third-party degradation
scenarios.story: Search gets slow, but only sometimes. The trace shows the time is not ours. One provider is the whole tail.

scenarios.name: Payment provider brownout
scenarios.story: Bookings stall at PENDING_PAYMENT. Error Tracking groups declines cleanly, the composite monitor fires, and the revenue widget dives.

scenarios.name: The missing index
scenarios.story: The account page times out. Database Monitoring shows the plan flip from Index Scan to Seq Scan, and the fix is one toggle away.

scenarios.name: Cache stampede to cascade
scenarios.story: A cold cache drives the GDS fan-out twenty-fold, the provider rate-limits, search errors, holds expire, and bookings fail. The full incident narrative.

scenarios.name: Slow consumer
scenarios.story: Bookings confirm but confirmation emails never arrive. Data Streams Monitoring shows exactly which hop is the problem, and the DLQ fills.

scenarios.name: The hot deploy
scenarios.story: p95 regresses right at a deployment marker. The profiler flame graph finds the loop, and Code Hotspots links to the line.

scenarios.name: Memory leak
scenarios.story: RSS climbs over twenty minutes, GC pressure rises, then the process OOMs and restarts.

scenarios.name: Frontend-only regression
scenarios.story: The backend is perfectly healthy and users complain anyway. Core Web Vitals and Session Replay make the invisible visible.

scenarios.name: AI support goes off the rails
scenarios.story: Support chat stops calling the booking tool and starts making things up. LLM Observability shows the tool-call failure and the token blowup.

scenarios.name: Lock contention
scenarios.story: Seat holds serialise. The wait profile and DBM blocking sessions converge on the same advisory lock.
